steps.title: Establishing the view
steps.text: Rest as awakened awareness until every event that arises reads as its radiance rather than a distraction from it.

steps.title: A demanding thought
steps.text: Take up a problem or a global crisis and see the hardest thinking as radiance, brighter for being hard.

steps.title: An intense emotion
steps.text: Recall a time you were badly triggered, evoke it, and stay in the ground while it burns.

steps.title: A difficult person
steps.text: Gods and demons: one person who felt wholly good or wholly unsafe, met as the display of awareness.

steps.title: Grief and suffering
steps.text: A time of real loss, felt on purpose, turning into an invitation to compassion.

steps.title: Sickness
steps.text: A time you were deeply ill, as a doorway into the shared humanity of sickness and age.

steps.title: Dying
steps.text: Approach your own death and the dissolution of earth, water, fire and air, staying in the view throughout.

Vase breathing and guru yoga, then the condensed instructions for recognition, one-taste sealing of every event and every limiting belief, radiance of thought, emotion and sensation, mixing while getting up and stretching, and finally the stainless ground and tracelessness. Path level, the yoga of non-meditation: the single most complete review recording, for when you want the whole curriculum in one sit.
